purpose: Requirements for the reviewer agent in the review mechanism: how it reads targets, judges target kinds, selects criteria documents per kind, and reports findings and its single error value.
summary: Overview: reviewer reads targets with suitable norms and reports errors without missing them; secret scanning is out of scope
Scope: only reviewer-specific behavior; exchange and data contracts are delegated to the common review contract
FNC-301: contents of the reviewer definition such as script usage, request item handling, and reading method
FNC-306: how targets are read for paths, base_branch and diff forms, including deletions and renames
FNC-307: target kind (code/requirement/design/plan/uxui) is judged from doc_structure settings via script, then file contents
FNC-308: per-kind tables of criteria documents, built-in norms, project-specific documents and cross-check targets
FNC-309: findings are returned only when present; zero findings with normal exit means no issues
FNC-315: the only error value is target_unreadable; unreadable documents and undeterminable kinds are not errors
tasks: Writing or modifying the reviewer agent definition
Changing criteria documents or norms mapped to target kinds
Designing target kind resolution in doc structure script
title: REQ-027 reviewer の入力・作業・出力の契約 要件定義書
